en: Saññojanasampayuttaduka (The Pair on Being Conjoined with the Fetters)
Dependent on a state associated with the fetters (*saññojana*), a state associated with the fetters arises by way of the root condition (*hetu-paccaya*).
Dependent on a state associated with the fetters, a state dissociated from the fetters arises by way of the root condition.
Dependent on a state associated with the fetters, a state both associated with the fetters and dissociated from the fetters [arises]...
And states arise by way of root condition.
Dependent on a state that is dissociated from the fetters, a state dissociated from the fetters arises by way of root condition.
Dependent on a state dissociated from the fetters, a state associated with the fetters arises by way of root condition.
Dependent on a state that is dissociated from the fetters, there arise states that are both associated with the fetters and dissociated from the fetters by way of the root condition.
Dependent on a state that is both associated with the fetters and dissociated from the fetters, there arises a state that is associated with the fetters... [and so forth].

A state arises by way of root condition. Dependent on a state that is both dissociated from the fetters and not dissociated from the fetters, a state that is not dissociated from the fetters arises by way of root condition.
Dependent on a state that is both dissociated from the fetters and not dissociated from the fetters, [a state] that is both associated with the fetters and not dissociated from the fetters [arises].
And mental phenomena arise with root-condition. (Abbreviated. Nine in the case of the root;
six in the case of the object; ... five in the case of the predominance; ... one in the case of the result; ... nine in the case of non-disappearance. (Full detail for all.)
